objective: Close authorization gaps on alert resolve and all recipe mutating routes: declare the missing events:write and recipe:write scopes and enforce scope + device-ownership checks (no silent bypass for API-key callers without a linked user).

acceptance.criterion: PUT /events/{id}/acknowledge (resolve_event) rejects callers with only read:telemetry and requires events:write
Recipe template CRUD (create_recipe, update_recipe, delete_recipe) rejects callers missing recipe:write
apply_recipe requires BOTH recipe:write scope and device ownership, and rejects API-key callers with no linked user instead of silently bypassing ownership
bulk_apply_recipe requires recipe:write in addition to the existing own-all-devices check
clear_recipe requires BOTH recipe:write scope and ownership of the path device_id (arbitrary device_ids can no longer be cleared by any logged-in user)
events:write and recipe:write are declared in KNOWN_SCOPES with descriptions, so role scopes referencing them validate and callers without them are rejected
